title: Customer documents
intro: The documents you can give the customer for this request, in the order you will normally need them.
chooseDocument: Choose the document you want to issue:
viewerHint: This is exactly what the customer will receive.

when.provisionalQuotation: Send this first, before availability is checked. It is only an estimate: it does not reserve anything or guarantee the price.
when.bookingConfirmation: Send this once the supplier has confirmed availability. It confirms the booking and tells the customer how much to pay and when.
when.paymentReceipt: Give the customer one of these each time you record a payment they have made.

confirmationLocked: Available once supplier availability is confirmed — move the request to Awaiting payment.

receipts.title: Payment receipts
receipts.empty: A receipt becomes available after a payment is recorded.

componentNote: Documents for this booking are issued from its journey {reference}.
componentNoteNoRef: Documents for this booking are issued from its journey.

errors.availability_not_confirmed: Availability isn't confirmed yet. Move the request to Awaiting payment first.
errors.component_of_journey: This booking is part of a journey — issue its documents from the journey.
errors.generic: Couldn't load the document. Please try again.

payments.receiptAria: Open the receipt for the payment of {amount}

blocked.convert_first: Convert this request first — payments can only be recorded once the journey has been converted.
blocked.awaiting_payment_first: Payments can be recorded once the request is Awaiting payment or Confirmed.
blocked.order_not_confirmed: Payments can be recorded once the order is confirmed.
